title: systemc-signoff-evidence: review reports, measurement scripts and data for Proof Before Push
description: Independent review reports, measurement scripts and data behind the report Proof Before Push, which applies a sign-off checklist (fail-then-pass test, baseline regression, clean build, independent review) to 58 change branches in four open SystemC verification libraries: SystemC, UVM-SystemC, CRAVE and FC4SC. Includes a manifest pinning each measured branch to its commit and instructions to reproduce Table 1.
